name: companion-ai
description: A small single-page web app with an AI companion built into it. Pixel lives in a panel beside the workspace content, talks casually, remembers what you tell it for the session, and changes its face depending on how the conversation is going.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
